event: A Guardian analysis of Anthropic’s listed IoT self-replication study added commentary from Joshua Saxe, who led development of Meta’s AI security effort, that potential effects warrant mitigation, and Ariel Herbert-Voss, an early security expert at OpenAI, that AI worms may adapt as they go. Other experts cited in the article said the scenario is slow and detectable. (anthropic.com, 2026-10-18.)
